full_track.tags: K-Pop ballad. Acoustic piano plays a steady eighth-note pattern in the mid-range. A clean electric guitar provides subtle arpeggiated fills with light chorus and reverb. The bass guitar enters with melodic slides and sustained root notes. Drums feature a soft kick and a crisp snare with a long reverb tail. A baritone male vocal delivers a smooth, legato melody in the lower register, transitioning to a breathy head voice in higher passages. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the piano and the vocal. Key of G Major, 72 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
